editorial:
If you love big, loud action movies with a buddy-cop feel, this one is right up your alley. Channing Tatum plays John Cale, a Capitol Policeman who just got turned down for his dream Secret Service job. To soften the blow for his daughter, he takes her on a White House tour, and that's exactly when armed attackers storm the building. Suddenly, Cale has to protect the President, played by Jamie Foxx, while also trying to find his daughter in the chaos. The vibe is pure summer blockbuster fun, mixing explosions, shootouts, and surprisingly funny banter between the two leads. It never takes itself too seriously, which makes it easy to enjoy.

The action scenes are big and well-staged, and Tatum and Foxx have great chemistry that carries the movie even when the plot gets silly. The pacing rarely slows down, though some twists feel predictable and the villains are a bit cartoonish. Still, if you want a fun, escapist night in, this delivers. Action fans and anyone who enjoys movies like Die Hard will have a blast. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: The final twist reveals that the Vice President is behind the attack, planning to take over the presidency. Cale fights through the attackers and rescues his daughter, while President Sawyer survives. In the climax, Cale stops the Vice President's plan and saves the day. The movie ends with Cale finally getting his Secret Service job and taking his daughter to a baseball game, where the President throws the first pitch, showing everything is back to normal and Cale is now a hero.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves big action movies and buddy-cop banter.
